node.statement: Repeated binary first-index splitting along P_[1,j]=P_[1,j-1]+P_j gives a bounded linear bijection S_{P,Q}->direct-sum_j S_{P_j,Q}; composing it with the finitely many fixed-j bijections gives S_{v(I_B),w(I_C)} linearly bijective to direct-sum_{j,k}S_{v(Pi_j),w(Sigma_k)}.
